activities.title: Christ Church & Mall Road Stroll
activities.description: Begin the day with a visit to Christ Church, the iconic neo‑Gothic church on Mall Road. After exploring the interior (free entry), enjoy a leisurely walk along Mall Road, soaking in the colonial architecture and local shops.

activities.title: Kalka–Shimla Railway Heritage Walk
activities.description: Walk to the historic Kalka–Shimla Railway station (≈5 min). View the vintage locomotives and learn about the UNESCO‑listed narrow‑gauge line. No entry fee.

activities.title: Lunch – Himachali Cuisine
activities.description: Enjoy a traditional Himachali thali at a popular local eatery on Mall Road (≈₹500 per person, including a soft drink).

activities.title: Jakhu Temple Visit
activities.description: Take a short auto‑rickshaw ride (≈3 km, 10‑15 min, ₹200 round‑trip) to Jakhu Temple, the highest point in Shimla. Explore the temple grounds and enjoy panoramic views of the city. Free entry.

activities.title: Viceregal Lodge (Rashtrapati Niwas)
activities.description: Travel by shared taxi (≈5 km, 15 min, ₹150 per person) to the Viceregal Lodge. Guided tour of the former British summer residence (entry fee ₹100 per person).

activities.title: Afternoon Tea on Mall Road
activities.description: Return to Mall Road (≈10 min walk). Relax with tea/coffee and a snack at a café (≈₹100 per person).

activities.title: Leisurely End & Departure
activities.description: Free time for last‑minute shopping or photo‑ops before concluding the day trip.
